services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Society has four distinct museums to accommodate all of your rental needs. We can host a variety of events including weddings, receptions, fundraisers, corporate events and meetings for groups of all sizes. Our iconic museums provide a truly memorable Key West experience. The iconic Key West Lighthouse & Keeper’s Quarters is the perfect setting for your special event. Opened in 1848, the grounds of Lighthouse & Keeper’s Quarters are able to accommodate 100-150 guests. The air-conditioned Keeper’s Quarters, with its wrap-around porch, is an ideal space for a bridal suite while the picturesque lofty fig tree (ficus altissima) is the ideal backdrop for wedding photos or ceremonies.
